reviewSource: Manual, per-item deterministic review for Fase 33's test-environment curated subset. Not a substitute for the professional/clinical allergen review still required before any production claim (see docs/nutrition/09_safety/professional_review_checklist.md). Items are single whole/minimally-processed ingredients except sourceId 401, a deliberately documented prepared-food exception whose conservative allergen tags follow directly from the named breaded preparation.
allergenScope: NUTRITION_FOOD_ALLERGENS = milk, egg, peanut, tree_nuts, soy, wheat, fish, shellfish, other. An empty allergens array means 'reviewed, none of these 9 tracked categories apply' — it is never a default; every item lists its own rationale.

items.name: Frango, filé, à milanesa
items.rationale: TACO prepared-food entry with measured, non-null fiber and explicit breaded-chicken naming. Chicken makes all non-omnivore flags false; a milanesa breading is conservatively tagged for egg and wheat. No nutrient value is overridden by this review. CORRECTED 2026-10-10 (diet-quality audit): breaded/fried preparation is `composite`, which is never eligible for AI generation regardless of allergen/dietary review — applyEnrichment.ts now resolves generationStatus to `blocked` for any composite preparation instead of unconditionally `approved`.
